bullets.text: Meta Revives Poke Feature - **Meta** reimagines Facebook's poke feature to engage Gen Z users in flirting.
tvOS 26 Enhances AirPlay - **Apple**'s tvOS 26 allows any AirPlay speaker to be a permanent audio output.
Apple Watch Ultra 3 Features - The upcoming **Apple Watch Ultra 3** promises a larger display and enhanced connectivity.
CarPlay Gets Tapbacks - **Apple**'s iOS 26 introduces tapbacks support for Messages in CarPlay.
AirPods Pro 3 Launch - **Apple**'s AirPods Pro 3 expected to feature upgraded noise cancellation and new design.
iPhone 17 Pro Rumors - The **iPhone 17 Pro** is rumored to have improved thermals for better performance.
Dyson's New Robot Cleaner - The **Dyson Spot+Scrub Ai** robot aims to tackle stains with AI technology.
OpenAI Restructures Team - **OpenAI** reorganizes its Model Behavior team to enhance AI model interactions.
Roblox Introduces Video Feed - **Roblox** launches a TikTok-like short-form video feed for gameplay clips.
Warner Bros. Sues Midjourney - **Warner Bros.** files a lawsuit against Midjourney for copyright infringement.
